card.name: Section and page references in text
card.fires_on: Words and numbers that point to another part of a document, such as page, line, scene, section, subsection, or 'of' after a section number. Also the last digit inside a numbered cross-reference like (5.12).

modes.label: Reference word
modes.description: A locator word such as section, scene, line or p. that is followed by a number or title.
modes.example: Act II,<< scene>> i The scene is the public square

modes.label: Numbered cross-reference
modes.description: The final digit inside a bracketed section number in a label cross-reference.

modes.label: 'of' after a section
modes.description: The word 'of' after a section or chapter name, pointing to a document or insert.
modes.example: as described in the dosage and administration section<< of>> this insert.

card.plain: It marks the spot where the text points the reader to another section, page or line.
